body.objective: Characterize Weyl gravity FULLY in the reverse-physics sense: for each layer of the theory, which minimal physical assumptions is the layer EQUIVALENT to, with independence witnesses and an honest ledger. Four layers. (1) THE ACTION is done: REVERSE_PHYSICS_WEYL_ACTION_V1 shows S = alpha int sqrt(-g) C^2 is equivalent to five assumptions rather than implied by six, with the derivative order DERIVED from D - 2k = 0 rather than assumed, and RP-PARITY independent on actions but redundant on field equations. (2) THE FIELD EQUATIONS were recorded as never computed by this stream; that was true of the stream and false of the repository, and the layer is now partly discharged (see current_gate). (3) THE GAUGE STRUCTURE (RP-DIFF, the BRST/BV complex) is UNTOUCHED and is the largest genuine hole: RP-DIFF is what makes 'the space of curvature scalars' the right space at all, so it never appears as a row in any matrix and has no independence witness. (4) THE SPECTRUM is partial: weyl-ghost-forced.md proves the uniqueness theorem and the ghost theorem are the same theorem, both following from D - 2k = 0; the DYNAMICAL consequence of the ghost is not characterized, and GHOST_MODEL_OBSTRUCTION showed the coprime obstruction does not decide it in either direction. Underneath all four sits the GEOMETRY column, which PHYSICS-VS-MATH.md itself calls 'the bulk of the intellectual content', imported and unverified.

body.current_gate: THE WEYL_ACTION_SIX_DERIVATIVE_D6 GATE IS NOW ANSWERED IN BOTH HALVES, IN FORGE. PARITY-EVEN, in two stages. REVERSE_PHYSICS_CUBIC_CONFORMAL_COUNT_V1 (rail 26/26): invariants cubic in Riemann with no derivatives number 1, 1, 2 across D = 4, 5, 6, with cubic curvature spans 6, 7, 8. REVERSE_PHYSICS_DERIVATIVE_CONFORMAL_COUNT_V1 (rail 33/33): adding grad R grad R and R grad grad R the counts become 2, 2, 3, so D = 6 MATCHES the cited 3 by computation and the derivative sector supplies exactly one more invariant in every dimension. PARITY-ODD: REVERSE_PHYSICS_PARITY_CONFORMAL_COUNT_V1 (rail 20/20) -- 2 in D = 4 at weight 6, 2 in D = 6 at weight 6, 1 in D = 4 at weight 4 (the Pontryagin density, the known-answer control), and NONE in odd dimensions by index counting rather than computation. So the D = 4 parity result DOES have a D = 6 analogue. THE SHAPE OF THE PARITY ANSWER: in both dimensions the parity-odd invariant content is exactly what the WEYL tensor supplies. The Riemann-built parity-odd candidates are mostly IDENTICALLY ZERO and the ones that are not are not invariant on their own; the invariants are the complete contractions of one epsilon with three Weyl tensors, which carry weight -6 uniformly and are therefore invariant by construction -- which makes them the positive control as well as the answer. HOW A LEVI-CIVITA TENSOR STAYS IN EXACT ARITHMETIC, since this is the reusable trick: eps = sqrt(|det g|) times the symbol, and that square root is not rational. Evaluate at a base point where |det g| = 1 and the tensor IS the symbol exactly. Free, because the fixtures are G = L S L^T with L unit lower-triangular over the integers, and a conformal partner with sigma vanishing at the base point has the same determinant. CHECKED, not assumed -- a non-unimodular mutation scores 18/20 failing exactly that. And eps is covariantly constant, so it passes through a covariant derivative for free. CAVEATS THAT MUST TRAVEL WITH ALL OF THESE COUNTS. Every one is a LOWER BOUND over the candidate families evaluated: box box R is absent from the parity-even count and two-epsilon candidates from the parity-odd one. Adding candidates can only raise a count -- a non-invariant candidate raises both ranks and leaves the difference alone -- so the direction is sound. The parity-even count exhibits no basis (the third D = 6 invariant is counted, not written down); the parity-odd count DOES exhibit its invariants. SUBSTRATE LANDED IN TANGO across seven pushed commits: metric_inverse, riemann_const, math/curvinv, jet_mul/jet_add made to scale with the old ones kept as ORACLES, jet_truncate, math/curvcov (covariant derivatives as Taylor coefficient arrays), math/levicivita (permutations by Lehmer decoding, contraction by slot spec). NEXT, in priority order. (1) THE SHARPER HALF OF THE PARITY RESULT, now the real remainder: the D = 4 statement is that parity is INDEPENDENT ON ACTIONS AND REDUNDANT ON FIELD EQUATIONS. What is computed here is only that parity-odd invariants EXIST at weight 6 in D = 6 and how many. Whether adjoining them leaves the field equations unchanged is a different computation and is NOT done. (2) EXACTNESS: box box R would turn the D = 6 parity-even lower bound into a count, and needs degree-6 jets, which the jet speedup may now make affordable. (3) EXHIBITING A BASIS for the parity-even sector. (4) C-GHOST-DYNAMICS remains the last OPEN row of the comparison ledger, and is now the largest untouched thing in the whole stream. DISCIPLINE NOTES THAT KEEP PAYING. Mutation testing found three defects in this session's own work that a passing exit code hid: an if/else precedence bug dropping the Hessian's factor of 2 on the diagonal; a gate whose own expect was miscounted at 16 against 17 checks, so it returned 16 and read as green while that bug failed; and a metric fixture in normal coordinates where Gamma(0) = 0 and every connection term was multiplied by zero. Separately, a parity run at six metrics reported ONE FEWER invariant than the truth and was caught ONLY by the saturation check -- the wrong number was not obviously wrong. And a diagnostic slot leaked into the candidate columns once, putting the scalar curvature into a parity-odd value matrix. Gates now PRINT which check failed.
body.stop_condition: EITHER every entry of the GEOMETRY column is discharged or explicitly cited to an existing certificate, the field-equation layer is characterized by variation rather than definition, and the gauge layer has at least one independence witness for RP-DIFF — at which point 'fully characterized' is a defensible claim for three of four layers with the fourth ledgered; OR a layer returns an exact obstruction showing the reverse-physics question is not well posed there, which is itself the deliverable and must be recorded with the same rails.
body.forbid: claiming any geometric fact is PROVED when it is DISCHARGED — the discharge verifies exactly at specific metrics, which is strictly stronger than an unverified import and strictly weaker than a theorem for all metrics, and the certificate must keep saying so in those words; asserting G8's W_pm^2 = (C^2 pm P)/2 without its signature qualification, since the Lorentzian Hodge star squares to -1 on two-forms (local_bv/hodge.py records eigenvalues pm i) so W_pm are complex conjugates there and the decomposition as stated is EUCLIDEAN; reinventing any convention this repository already maintains — three attempts in this stream (Riemann tensor, Bach tensor, action variation) each concluded 'we do not have this' about the STREAM while the REPOSITORY had it, and the fourth (the Hodge dual) produced a wrong normalization; promoting a discharge on a Ricci-flat metric to a statement about the R^2 or Ric^2 coefficients, which VANISH there and cannot be seen; using any certificate in this stream as evidence inside the Weyl classical or quantum chains — the one-way direction is load-bearing and is scanned by REVERSE_PHYSICS_CHAIN_IMPORTS_V1. THE CONVERSE IS NO LONGER FORBIDDEN: citing INTO this stream from the Weyl chains is permitted under four conditions (C1 no cycles, C2 tags travel, C3 pinned and fail-closed, C4 middle column only), because circularity requires a cycle and the dependency has always been one-way, while tag laundering is prevented by carrying the boundary rather than by refusing to cite. Stating a claim here at a dependency tag its imports do not support IS forbidden, and is checked mechanically; treating the coprime/ghost toy-model results as statements about Weyl gravity, which they explicitly are not.
